verdict.rationale: Postman offers Agent Mode for natural-language control of the API lifecycle (send requests, fix errors, update tests) and an official MCP server enabling AI-agent integration, both documented and probed live (auth-gated). However, evidence is vendor-doc/probe only, with no community validation of natural-language UX quality, and community feedback focuses on unrelated pain points (cloud lock-in, telemetry), leaving real-world reliability of AI-native command flows unconfirmed.
